products.name: Comet ML
products.note: ML experiment management; model monitoring; production tracking; team collaboration

reading.body:
Comet sells developer tools for tracking and monitoring machine learning systems, with a focus on observability for large language models and agentic AI systems.

The company positions itself at a point of leverage in AI infrastructure. As models grow larger and teams deploy more complex systems, the ability to trace what a model does, why it cost what it cost, and where it failed becomes a production necessity. Comet's emphasis on LLM tracing, cost tracking, and agent testing reflects this shift. Developers cannot optimize what they cannot see. The platform's 60+ integrations and 40+ evaluation metrics suggest an attempt to make observability work across the fragmented ecosystem of model providers and deployment patterns that now exists.

This layer matters for compute efficiency specifically. Cost Intelligence tracking of Claude and Codex usage across context retrieval and model selection directly addresses how teams manage their spending on inference. As compute becomes more constrained by grid capacity and power availability, visibility into which models consume what resources and why becomes a constraint on how teams scale. A developer who knows their system is using 10x more tokens than necessary for the same output can reduce demand before it hits the infrastructure layer.

The data does not cover Comet's own infrastructure footprint, customer base, or whether teams actually change behavior based on its visibility tools. It shows what the company claims to do, not whether doing so moves the needle on actual compute efficiency in deployed systems.

profile_text.body:
Comet describes itself as an AI developer platform and the creator of Opik, which it characterizes as an end-to-end AI observability platform for developers covering agent testing, optimization, and monitoring. Opik provides LLM tracing across complex generative AI systems, with support for over 60 integrations, and includes evaluation capabilities built around more than 40 LLM-as-a-judge metrics, test suites with pass/fail scoring, and golden datasets. The platform also offers production dashboards, alerting, model cost tracking, and a feature called Cost Intelligence that gives visibility into engineering teams' usage of Claude Code and Codex across MCP installs, model selection, and context retrieval.

Alongside Opik, Comet offers a product called Comet ML, tracked in the site's registry under the category of coding and developer tools, which covers ML experiment management, model monitoring, production tracking, and team collaboration. The broader MLOps platform allows developers to log code, hyperparameters, and model predictions, and includes custom visualizations, model versioning, dataset management, and production monitoring. No litigation, SEC filings, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for this company.
